title: Best Bookshelf (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Picks were chosen from the listed sources, favoring products mentioned by multiple sites and covering both furniture and audio options.
assumptions: No price info was used except where a source gave a figure; all other cost considerations are omitted.

verdict.line: Buy it if you want a speaker that doubles as a shelf and works with Sonos multi‑room, AirPlay 2 and Spotify. It fits any décor and can be wall‑mounted, though you must buy brackets separately. The catch is it lacks Bluetooth.
